sources.title: Illustrious - Learn AI
sources.snippet: Illustrious is an open-source text-to-image generative model developed by OnomaAI Research, built upon the Stable Diffusion XL architecture and fine-tuned on the Danbooru2023 dataset to specialize in the generation of high-quality anime and illustration-style artwork.
